task:
Open LibreOffice Calc and change two user preferences so that they persist in the user profile:

1. Set 'Number of worksheets in new document' to 3.
2. Set 'Always save as' for 'Spreadsheet' documents to 'ODF Spreadsheet (*.ods)'.

Save the settings, and make sure the preferences flush to ~/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu.

verification.description: Default sheet count for new workbooks = 3
Default save format for Calc is ODF Spreadsheet (.ods)
